title: Code for cross-model replications of five LLM-based social simulation paradigms
description: Code used to run five published social-simulation paradigms on contemporary large language models through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and to parse and analyse the responses: a behavioural Turing test, simulated altruism, identity-prompted generation, generation and scoring of resumes, and a multi-agent naming game. The model responses are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22914156.
